claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_triggered_item_rider
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item combines a normal passive held benefit with an always-on automatic trigger that listens for nearby ranged-weapon targeting and redirects the attack without spending an action, reaction, or resource. Existing magic-item families only cover passive grants, activated abilities, triggered reactions that consume reaction quota, or spawned creatures.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever an attack with a Ranged weapon targets a creature within 10 feet of you, the curse causes you to become the target instead.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: redirect_targeting
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The curse deterministically changes the target of a qualifying attack from the original creature to the wielder. The current effect surface has no targeting-redirection atom; block/negate/reflect do not model 'become the target instead' for weapon attacks.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the curse causes you to become the target instead

claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_operation.on_nearby_attack_targets_creature
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The only passive item operation trigger currently available is elapsed time. This item needs an event trigger keyed to a nearby attack-targeting event with weapon-category and radius filters.
